snippet.title: The cozy, healing puzzle game 🐱 Meow Star Archives Demo is now live!
snippet.description:
#steam #indiegame #cozygaming #catgame #demo 
My playable demo is finally on Steam!

It's a relaxing, heartwarming cat-themed puzzle game.
In the game, you'll need to restore severely damaged memory archives of cats to prevent their souls from fading away. As you piece the archives back together, you'll also uncover the stories these adorable cats lived before they returned to the stars!

Come try it out — and I'd love to hear your feedback. Whether it's suggestions for improvement, thoughts on the story, or just something that didn't feel quite right, I'll read every comment carefully.

As long as you remember them, they will always be with you.
If you enjoy cute cats and cozy puzzle games, I'd be truly grateful if you could add it to your wishlist. Thank you so much! 😸
